sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B - Jetson AI Lab
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B is Qwen's dense, open-weight vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. It brings the strongest generation of Qwen open models to a deployment-friendly size, with better planning and stronger handling of tool and environment feedback for more reliable multi-step task completion.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B (2026): The Complete Guide to Qwen's New 27B Vision ...
sources.snippet: The key word is dense. Unlike the giant Qwen3.8-Max (2.4T-parameter MoE) that grabbed headlines when its weights landed on August 8, 2026, Qwen3.8-27B is a 27B-parameter dense model designed to run on hardware individuals actually own.
